data.description:
## Context / Problem

The S3 ticket-store backend (parent epic) is only usable if operators can discover the
optional dependency and configure S3 from the docs alone — today `docs/config.md` documents
`sync.remote` (line ~128) and `tracker.branch` (line ~154) only for the GitHub/git case, and
nothing names the `git-remote-s3` dependency, the SSE-KMS bucket setup, or the auto-doctor
behavior. This story documents the feature and records the architecture decision. It is
documentation-only; the code lands in the sibling stories.

## Approach

1. **`docs/config.md`** — under the `sync` section, document that `sync.remote` may point at a
   git remote whose URL is `s3://bucket/prefix` (or `s3+zip://`), served by the optional
   `git-remote-s3` helper, and that this keeps ticket history entirely out of GitHub. Cross-
   link the new backend page.
2. **New `docs/s3-backend.md`** — the operator guide: (a) install the optional dependency
   (`pip install '.[s3]'`, minimum `git-remote-s3>=0.3.2`); (b) create the SSE-KMS bucket
   (default encryption with a customer CMK, versioning on, public-access-block on) and the
   IAM policy scoped to the bucket + CMK; (c) add the git remote (`git remote add <name>
   s3://bucket/prefix`) and set `sync.remote` to it; (d) the **trust boundary**: AWS
   credentials come from the standard boto3 chain (never stored in rebar config or events),
   data at rest is SSE-KMS in the customer bucket, S3 access is IAM/SigV4 (no anonymous
   access); (e) operational behavior: the non-interactive auto-doctor self-heals a
   multiple-bundles state by merge (no data loss), and a stale lock self-heals via the
   helper's 60s TTL auto-steal (a rare, bounded delay — intentionally not lowered).
3. **New `docs/adr/0062-s3-ticket-store-backend.md`** — record the decision: use
   `awslabs/git-remote-s3` (Apache-2.0, maintained) below rebar's shell-out git layer so the
   event/data format is unchanged; SSE-KMS (not client-side) is acceptable per requirements;
   the multi-bundle risk is handled by a rebar merge-based auto-doctor because upstream's
   `git-s3 doctor` is interactive and discards a head; lowering the lock TTL was rejected.
   Follow the format of the existing ADRs (e.g. `docs/adr/0061-*`).
4. **`docs/README.md`** (docs index) and, if it lists extras, a one-line pointer — link the
   new backend page and ADR so they are discoverable.

Rationale: a dedicated backend page plus an ADR matches how rebar already documents optional
capabilities and architecture decisions (the `docs/adr/` series), giving operators a single
configuration entry point and preserving the decision record the maintainability criterion
expects; keeping it docs-only avoids coupling the write-up to any one code story's landing.

## Scope

- `docs/config.md` — extend the `sync.remote` documentation for the `s3://` case.
- `docs/s3-backend.md` — new operator guide (install, bucket/KMS/IAM, config, trust
  boundary, self-heal behavior).
- `docs/adr/0062-s3-ticket-store-backend.md` — new ADR.
- `docs/README.md` — add index links to the two new pages.

No code, schema, or test changes.

## Testing

Documentation-only; no automated test tier applies (mechanical prose changes, consistent
with how other `docs/` and ADR changes land). Validation is by review against the acceptance
checks below.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docs/config.md` documents that `sync.remote` accepts an `s3://bucket/prefix` remote
      served by the optional `git-remote-s3` helper and links `docs/s3-backend.md`. Verified
      by the section being present and cross-linked.
- [ ] `docs/s3-backend.md` exists and contains all five subsections: install (naming
      `pip install '.[s3]'` and the `git-remote-s3>=0.3.2` minimum), SSE-KMS bucket + IAM/CMK
      setup, remote + `sync.remote` configuration, the credentials/encryption trust boundary,
      and the auto-doctor + 60s stale-lock self-heal behavior. Verified by the named
      subsections being present.
- [ ] `docs/adr/0062-s3-ticket-store-backend.md` exists, follows the existing ADR format, and
      records the git-remote-s3 choice, SSE-KMS decision, the merge-based auto-doctor
      rationale (vs upstream's interactive/discarding doctor), and the rejected TTL-lowering.
      Verified by the ADR sections being present.
- [ ] `docs/README.md` links both new pages so they are discoverable from the docs index.
      Verified by the links being present.
data.title: Document the optional S3 dependency, S3/SSE-KMS configuration, and the backend ADR
